description: This file contains utility objects for handling error messages and exceptions in Apache Spark, including error message formatting, retrieval, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: ErrorMessageFormat
classes.description: Enumeration for different error message formats (PRETTY, MINIMAL, STANDARD, DEBUG).

classes.name: SparkThrowableHelper
classes.description: Object providing methods to construct, format, and retrieve error messages and related information for Spark exceptions.

methods.name: getMessageTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves the default message template for a given error class.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Constructs an error message based on error class, message parameters, and optional context.

methods.name: formatErrorMessage
methods.description: Formats the error message with optional SQL state and context information.

methods.name: getSqlState
methods.description: Retrieves the SQL state code associated with an error class.

methods.name: isValidErrorClass
methods.description: Checks if an error class is valid.

methods.name: getMessageParameters
methods.description: Retrieves message parameters for a given error class.

methods.name: getBreakingChangeInfo
methods.description: Provides information about breaking changes related to an error class.

methods.name: isInternalError
methods.description: Determines if an error class indicates an internal error.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Generates a formatted error message from a SparkThrowable instance based on specified format.
